source_documents.title: Thermochromic aggregation-induced dual phosphorescence via temperature-dependent sp3-linked donor-acceptor electronic coupling

reference_evidence_units.quote: the TPA6 solid exhibits a ﬂuorescence emission at 425 nm (τ = 0.7 ns)
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA6
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solid in air at room temperature, Figure 7b.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Prompt fluorescence is reported at 425 nm with 0.7 ns lifetime.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is distinct from the delayed phosphorescence band.

reference_evidence_units.quote: an RTP emission band can be collected at 550 nm with a lifetime of 83 ms in air at room temperature
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA6
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports long-lived 550 nm emission and visible afterglow.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No added PMMA matrix is used for this target.

reference_evidence_units.quote: a new phosphores- cence band (T1H) appears with an emission maximum at 455 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA6
reference_evidence_units.statement: A higher-energy delayed band emerges on cooling.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A new band alone does not prove a higher electronic Tn state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: no PMMA matrix is needed for the TPA6-based phosphorescence sensing module
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA6
reference_evidence_units.statement: The target is used as a solid-state temperature reporter without PMMA.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The detailed PMMA and AIE-mixture controls on TPA1-5 are not target-6 experiments.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the presence of a TPA-localized T1L state, which couples to a higher acceptor T1H state at room temperature
reference_evidence_units.subject: TPA1-6 design family
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Authors' general interpretation and TPA6 application.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Dual phosphorescence is interpreted via temperature-dependent communication between locally emitting triplet configurations.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: The detailed calculations are on TPA1 and TPA4, not TPA6.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Temperature-dependent redistribution between delayed bands is the sensor's source explanation.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Target-specific delayed emission and long lifetime support RTP.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Do not transfer the TPA1-5 water-fraction experiment to TPA6. A common design alone is insufficient for a separate target-specific RIM label.
